title: Strip the working before it ships
statement: Strip drafting, self-checking and debug text from an item before a student or a judge sees it.
example: After fields outside the delivery format were dropped, 30 of 30 winning items in a random live sample passed validation.
detail: A draft-verify-revise spec for document-based items expected its verification text to be penalised, since the grader scores a meta-pedagogical voice negatively, as an earlier paraphrase experiment had shown; the generator checklist bans any 'this question tests…' preamble visible to students. A saved winning item failed delivery validation because it still carried pipeline metadata, and after non-schema fields were dropped, 30 of 30 winners in a random live sample passed. The weekly report concluded that debug metadata belongs in archives and logs, not delivered payloads.

evidence.quote: The verification meta-text WILL be penalized — IB rubric scores presence of meta-pedagogical voice negatively (we saw this in R10 paraphrase-composition).
- [ ] No "this question tests…" preamble visible to students
- winner/scoring rows drop non-schema item fields
- random-30 live gate winners: 30/30 passed OpenAPI validation
Debug metadata belongs in archives/logs, not official payloads.
